page_title: MNU 1-0 FUL | Manchester Utd v Fulham 16/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+4' Bernd Leno doesn't have to worry about this one. Marcus Rashford plays a pass into the feet of Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
90+3' Great teamplay by Manchester Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90+1' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Sasa Lukic will be replaced by Jay Stansfield (Fulham).
90+1' Substitution. Andreas Pereira makes his way off the pitch and Harrison Reed (Fulham) comes on as his replacement.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham are awarded a free kick.

87' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Alejandro Garnacho. The score is now 1:0.

87' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Manchester Utd are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
85' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) makes a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Substitution. Kobbie Mainoo did his best and is replaced by Scott McTominay (Manchester United).

82' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
81' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) replaces Noussair Mazraoui.
81' Here comes a substitution. Jonny Evans (Manchester United) is brought on as a substitute for Harry Maguire.

80' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Bernd Leno makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
79' Dangerous play by Diogo Dalot (Manchester United). Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harry Wilson (Fulham) replacing Adama Traore.
78' Substitution. Rodrigo Muniz will be replaced by Raul Jimenez (Fulham).
76' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
75' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. It will be a corner kick for Fulham.
74' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Fulham can continue in their attacking effort.
73' Tom Cairney (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
70' The referee gives a yellow card to Andreas Pereira (Fulham) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
69' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
66' Casemiro (Manchester United) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
65' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
64' Here is a change. Emile Smith Rowe is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Tom Cairney (Fulham).
63' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
63' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the top left corner, but Andre Onana keeps it out with an amazing save.
61' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Mason Mount is replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch so that Amad Diallo can be given a rest.
59' Wonderful movement by Manchester Utd. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

56' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) unleashes a superb first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) launches a cross from the corner, but Bernd Leno is alert to thwart the effort.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

53' Mason Mount (Manchester United) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Bernd Leno anticipates well and smothers the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.

53' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
52' Robert Jones interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marcus Rashford (Manchester United). A free kick is awarded to Fulham.
50' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
49' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Fulham will take a corner.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
47' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Fulham win a corner.
46' Manchester Utd are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
43' Adama Traore (Fulham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
42' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Casemiro (Manchester United), but his powerful first-time effort flies high over the bar.
40' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) gets booked for the first time in this match.
40' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
39' The Manchester Utd players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Casemiro (Manchester United), but it's just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
36' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) will take the corner.

34' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Bernd Leno anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

32' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Bruno Fernandes, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.

31' Manchester Utd are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

29' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno pulls off an easy save.
28' Fulham are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

27' Casemiro (Manchester United) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
25' The referee gives a yellow card to Calvin Bassey (Fulham).

24' Casemiro (Manchester United) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
23' Manchester Utd keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
22' Kenny Tete (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
19' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
18' Mason Mount (Manchester United) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

15' Casemiro (Manchester United) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
15' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Manchester Utd will take a free kick.
13' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

13' Kenny Tete (Fulham) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the top right corner, but Andre Onana made a crucial save! The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
12' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

12' Manchester Utd slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
8' Adama Traore (Fulham) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
7' Adama Traore (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
6' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a nice lofted cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort is plucked out of the air by Andre Onana.
5' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Jones blows for a foul. Fulham win a free kick.
5' The Fulham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Neat passing move from Manchester Utd in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Fulham will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Jones.
